name: Siddharth Deshpande-Sengupta
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Siddharth Deshpande-Sengupta are wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 55, the augmentation scarring around their temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster — and they make no effort to hide it.

Their entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. They work as a wheelman out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Siddharth Deshpande-Sengupta operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
psychology.secret: Deniz Malm-Amoah witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Get in, sit down, hold on. Questions can wait until we're not being shot at."
"This vehicle has been modified for speed, armor, and my personal comfort. Two of those help you."
"I know every street in this district the way you know your own face."

story_hooks: The fixer who handles Deniz Malm-Amoah's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
A dead drop Deniz Malm-Amoah maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Deniz Malm-Amoah intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Deniz Malm-Amoah is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When they make a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of their stories.
augmentations: Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster. Internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on demand
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
breaking_points: Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
A child being put in danger as leverage against them

physical_description.heritage: South Asian foundation (40.1%) providing warm brown undertones and facial structure, enriched by Northern European (19.8%) contribution to bone definition and eye depth. East Asian (16.2%) and Southeast Asian (11.1%) ancestry create subtle epicanthic eye shape and facial proportions with defined cheekbones. Central Asian (12.8%) adds angular definition. The genetic mix produces a distinctive face with prominent cheekbones displaying both South Asian fullness and East Asian angularity, warm complex undertones throughout, and richly saturated skin with golden-copper saturation.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with compressed muscle density — the frame of someone who converts nervous energy into motion. Minimal body fat; shoulders slightly forward from years of gripping steering wheels and control surfaces.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm brown with golden and copper undertones, reflecting South Asian foundation with Northern European and East Asian modulation. Warm saturation across cheekbones and forehead with subtle complexity from the five-region blend. Slight translucence suggesting cardiovascular strain from stimulant cycles.
physical_description.complexion: South Asian bone structure with prominent, well-defined cheekbones and defined jawline, refined by Northern European angularity and East Asian eye shape. Southeast Asian influence visible in subtle facial proportions and soft tissue distribution. Fine lines around eyes and mouth from decades of squinting through windscreens and maintaining focus. Jaw is defined but carries visible scarring from augmentation installation.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with natural dark roots showing beneath
physical_description.hair_style: Short, swept back, functional rather than styled
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome visible along the left jawline and temple where synthetic blood infusion ports are installed — a metallic sheen visible under skin, particularly noticeable under Canopy's elevated lighting. No attempt to hide the installation; scars are deliberately left raw. Subtle LED pulse visible at the temple under certain angles when circulation is heightened.
distinguishing_marks: Jagged surgical scar running from left temple to jawline, approximately 12cm, with visible chrome integration points along the line — installation scarring that shows no attempt at concealment or cosmetic refinement
Smaller augmentation scars at both temples where neural interfaces were anchored, faint white lines barely visible under short hair
Thin, hairline scar across the back of the right hand — old injury, pre-augmentation
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless, economical motion — hands rarely still, fingers often drumming or making subtle adjustment gestures as if calibrating invisible controls. Sits forward in chairs. Walks with a forward-leaning gait that suggests perpetual motion. Eyes track movement compulsively — a habit from high-speed operations that never fully disengages.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian: reinforced synthmesh jacket in matte charcoal, multiple deep pockets and anchor points for safety gear. Fitted black cargo pants with integrated knee pads and thigh storage. Steel-toed boots, recently maintained. No corporate branding. Wears a pair of fingerless driving gloves (worn leather, custom-fitted) almost constantly. A single piece of jewelry — a battered platinum ring on the right ring finger, pre-augmentation, kept as anchor to civilian identity.
